phases.title: Always-On Home Wi-Fi & Sonos Network Intelligence Platform (Backend + PC/Web Frontend on Mini PC)

rounds.fixes: Resolved F-01 (lower-5-octet BSSID matching for EAP650 virtual SSIDs + exact BaseMAC+1 SonosNet BSSID matching), F-02 (ConnectionMode-scoped grading for STATION_MODE, active FORWARDING root-port SNR, ETHERNET_ROOT/NODE, and 0,0,0,0/None normalization), F-03 (Netgear GS316EP BPDU pass-through lowest-MAC STP root usurpation guard when wiring secondary rooms), F-04 (per-consumer PhyErrorRate delta cursors, cold 2-sample probe, and reboot counter reset handling), and F-05 (nested Satellite parsing for Fernsehecke RR, Eltern->Elternschlafzimmer room mapping, insert-if-absent seeding, soft-archive, and unified REST/WS route paths).
Verified all Round 1 fixes and cross-document interactions clean.

Resolved CF-01 (PlayerTelemetryDto attribute mapping to base_mac/sonosnet_bssid), CF-02 (connection_mode preservation for Station Mode/HT Satellite), CF-03 (Pillar schema and UI contract alignment for summary_note, total_players, stp_guard_note), and CF-04 (telemetry snapshot scoping in compute_survey_delta).

Resolved CF2-01: replaced strict <= target.captured_at filter with closest-in-time snapshot batch selection across distinct timestamps, ensuring post-remediation PHY error drops are accurately reflected across all rooms without timestamp mismatch exclusion.
Verified all Round 1 and Round 2 fixes clean. All 34 backend tests and 9 frontend tests pass. Deployed and verified on Mini PC production.
